intro.heading: Introduction
intro.p1: Codamium ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our platform.
intro.p2: Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our platform.

account.heading: Account Information
account.body: When you create an account, we collect information such as your email address, username, display name, profile picture, and bio. We also store your password in hashed form for authentication purposes.

content.heading: User-Generated Content
content.body: We collect and store the articles, comments, and other content you create on our platform, including metadata such as publication date, category, and engagement metrics.

usage.heading: Usage and Analytics Data
usage.body: We automatically collect information about your interactions with our platform, including pages visited, content viewed, time spent on pages, and click patterns. This information is used to improve our services and understand user behavior.

device.heading: Device Information
device.body: We collect information about the devices you use to access our platform, including device type, operating system, browser type, and IP address.

jwt.heading: JWT Tokens
jwt.body: We use JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authentication and authorization. These tokens contain encrypted information about your session and are stored securely in your browser. JWTs allow you to stay logged in across pages without repeatedly entering your credentials.

session.heading: Session Cookies
session.body: We may use session cookies to maintain your logged-in state and provide personalized experiences. These cookies are deleted when you close your browser or explicitly log out.

preference.heading: Preference Cookies
preference.body: We use preference cookies to remember your settings and preferences, such as display language, theme selection, and notification preferences.

usage.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
list: To provide, maintain, and improve our platform and services
To authenticate your identity and manage your account
To personalize your experience and deliver targeted content
To communicate with you about updates, announcements, and promotional offers
To monitor and analyze trends and usage patterns for platform improvements
To enforce our Terms of Service and other agreements
To protect against fraudulent, malicious, or illegal activity

sharing.heading: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share your information in the following circumstances:

list.label: Service Providers:
list.text: With trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform, subject to confidentiality agreements

list.label: Legal Compliance:
list.text: When required by law or government requests

list.label: Safety and Protection:
list.text: To protect our rights, privacy, safety, or property

list.label: Public Profiles:
list.text: Your public profile information (username, display name, bio) is visible to all users

security.heading: 5. Data Security
security.intro: We implement appropriate technical, administrative, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Our security measures include:
list: HTTPS encryption for all data transmitted between your browser and our servers
Password hashing using industry-standard algorithms
Secure JWT token generation and validation
Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
security.outro: However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. While we strive to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

rights.heading: 6. Your Rights
rights.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal information:

list.label: Access:
list.text: You can request access to the personal information we hold about you

list.label: Correction:
list.text: You can update or correct your account information through your profile settings

list.label: Deletion:
list.text: You can request deletion of your account and associated data

list.label: Opt-out:
list.text: You can opt out of promotional communications at any time

retention.heading: 7. Data Retention
retention.body: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymize your personal data within 30 days, except where legal obligations require us to retain it.

children.heading: 8. Children's Privacy
children.body: Our platform is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child under 13, we will take steps to delete such information promptly.

changes.heading: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any material changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Your continued use of our platform following such changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated Privacy Policy.

contact.heading: 10. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us at:
contact.responseTime: Response time: We aim to respond within 7 business days

acceptableUse.outro: We reserve the right to remove any content that violates these rules and to suspend or terminate the accounts of users who engage in prohibited activities.

suspension.heading: Account Suspension and Termination
